transcript.en: Hello Dr Green - I’m here to talk to you about my work placement
transcript.zh: 你好，格林博士 -我在这里和你谈谈我的工作实习。

transcript.en: Oh yes, it's Holly, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 哦，是的，是Holly，不是吗？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: So, which work placement have you chosen?
transcript.zh: 那么，你选择了哪种工作实习？

transcript.en: I decided to go for the Orion Stadium placement.
transcript.zh: 我决定去猎户座体育场。

transcript.en: The event I'll be managing is one where I'm helping to set up a sports competition for primary school children.
transcript.zh: 我将要负责的活动是帮助小学生举办体育比赛的活动。

transcript.en: Yup. That's always a popular placement even though it can be tougher than you think working with children.
transcript.zh: 是的。这一直是一个受欢迎的职位 - 即使它可能比你想象的与孩子一起工作更加困难。

transcript.en: I know, but it's the fresh air that attracts me  organising something indoors doesn't have the same appeal, even though it might be fun.
transcript.zh: 我知道，但吸引我的是新鲜空气——在室内组织一些活动并没有同样的吸引力，即使它可能很有趣。

transcript.en: OK, so obviously safety's going to be one of your key concerns for this event.
transcript.zh: 好的，所以很明显，安全将是你这次活动的主要关注点之一。

transcript.en: Yes, I've already thought about that. I'll need to make sure none of the equipment's damaged.
transcript.zh: 是的我已经想过了。我需要确保没有任何设备损坏。

transcript.en: Ah well, you'll be working with schools, so the equipment will be their responsibility. However, the grounds and what goes on there will be yours.
transcript.zh: 嗯，你会和学校一起工作，所以设备将是他们的责任。但是，场地以及场地上发生的事情将会是你的责任。

transcript.en: Oh I see ，that’ll include keeping everyone within the boundary once they’re in their kit and on the field?
transcript.zh: 哦，我明白了——一旦他们穿上球衣或者进入场地就要保证他们不能出事。

transcript.en: Exactly ，you’ll need to inspect areas like changing rooms as well for anything someone can trip over,but your main priority will be not to lose anyone!
transcript.zh: 确切地说 - 你需要检查更衣室等区域，以及任何有可能绊倒他们的东西，但你的首要任务是不要弄丢任何人！

transcript.en: Right. I'll need staff to help with that.
transcript.zh: 对。我需要工作人员的帮助。

transcript.en: And don't forget about the spectators.
transcript.zh: 别忘了观众。

transcript.en: Mmm. I was thinking that many of them will be parents, who could help run the event.
transcript.zh: 嗯。我在想，他们中的很多人都是会家长，可以帮助举办这次活动。

transcript.en: I wouldn't rely on that. They'll be more interested in filming their children than  volunteering.
transcript.zh: 我不会依赖这个。他们对拍摄孩子比对做志愿服务更感兴趣。

transcript.en: I'll need to make sure they don't interfere with events doing that!
transcript.zh: 我需要确保他们的拍摄不会干扰活动的进行！

transcript.en: And that's not always easy,  especially when a proud parent's trying to get a snap of their child and you want them to move elsewhere.
transcript.zh: 这并不总是那么容易，尤其是当一个骄傲的父母试图抓拍他们的孩子，而你希望他们挪到其他地方。

transcript.en: OK. What about the scheduling?
transcript.zh: 好的。日程安排如何？

transcript.en: With sporting events there are all sorts of things that can alter the timetable- like rain, for instance though so far, we’ve always been lucky with that.
transcript.zh: 对于体育赛事，有各种各样的事情可以改变时间表 - 例如下雨 - 尽管到目前为止，我们一直很幸运。

transcript.en: Yeah, and I was thinking about what to do if someone got hurt as well. I know that last year that caused a terrible delay.
transcript.zh: 是的，我也在想，如果有人也受伤了，该怎么办。我知道，去年的受伤造成了可怕的延误。

transcript.en: You have to be prepared for such things.
transcript.zh: 你必须为这样的事情做好准备。

transcript.en: Oh. What if a match ends in a draw do you let the teams keep going until someone wins?
transcript.zh: 哦。如果一场比赛以平局告终，你会让队伍继续进行直到一队获胜吗？

transcript.en: That'll be up to you ，and again, you need to plan for it
transcript.zh: 这取决于你 - 再说一遍，你需要为此做好准备。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Now, the aim of your work placement is to give you the opportunity to develop the skills  that an events manager needs. So, let's talk about those a bit.
transcript.zh: 现在，你的实习的目的是锻炼你的活动管理者的技能。活动管理者 所以，让我们稍微谈谈这些。

transcript.en: Well, I think my communication skills are pretty good. I can talk on the phone to people and book venues and that kind of thing.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我认为我的沟通技巧很好。我可以做和人们通电话，预订场地之类的事情。

transcript.en: Good . just remember it isn’t only about what you say If you meet someone face-to-face and want to persuade them to be a sponsor, for example ...
transcript.zh: 很好 - 只要记住，这不仅仅是关于你说的话。.例如，如果你面对面地遇到某人，并希望说服他们成为赞助商.....

transcript.en: Oh, I'll dress up for that! Sure.
transcript.zh: 哦，我确定要为此打扮好。

transcript.en: Good. Let's go on to think about your organisational skills. You're working in a very people-based industry and that means things won't always go to plan.
transcript.zh: 好。让我们继续来考虑你的组织技能。你在一个非常以人为本的行业工作，这意味着事情并不总是按计划进行。

transcript.en: I guess it's being prepared to make changes that matters.
transcript.zh: 我想它需要准备好因一些重要的事情做出改变。

transcript.en: That's right. You may have to make an on-the-spot change to a timetable?because of a problem you hadn't anticipated ...
transcript.zh: 是的。你可能不得不对时间表进行现场更改，因为你没有预料到的问题......

transcript.en: ... just do it! OK.
transcript.zh: 只管去做！可以的。

transcript.en: How's your time management these days?
transcript.zh: 这些天你的时间管理怎么样？

transcript.en: I'm working on it - I’m certainly better when I have a deadline,which is why this work suits me.
transcript.zh: 我正在做这件事——当我有截止日期的时候，我确定会更好，这就是为什么这份工作适合我。

transcript.en: Yes, but it's how you respond as that deadline approaches!
transcript.zh: 是的，但这是你在最后期限临近时的反应！

transcript.en: I know I've got to look calm even if I'm in a panic.
transcript.zh: 我知道即使我处于恐慌之中，我也必须要看上去冷静。

transcript.en: Just think to yourself - no one must know I’m under pressure.
transcript.zh: 只想你自己——没有人必须知道我承受着压力。

transcript.en: Yeah - even though I’m multi-tasking like crazy!
transcript.zh: 是的 - 即使我疯狂地同时处理多个任务！

transcript.en: Another skill that events managers need is creativity. Often your client has what we call the 'big picture' idea, but it's up to the events manager to think of all the fine points that go to making it work.
transcript.zh: 活动管理者需要的另一项技能是创造力。通常，你的客户会有我们所说的“大局”想法，但是由活动经理来考虑所有操作细节。

transcript.en: Right, so I need to listen carefully to that idea and then fill in all the gaps.
transcript.zh: 是的，所以我需要仔细听这个想法，然后填补所有的空白。

transcript.en: That's right. And you'll have a team working under you, so another key skill is leadership. Your team may have lots of ideas too, but you've got to make the ultimate choices.
transcript.zh: 是的。你下面会有一个团队在工作，所以另一个关键技能是领导力。你的团队可能也有很多想法，但你必须做出最终的选择。

transcript.en: Do we have refreshments inside or out, for example?
transcript.zh: 例如，我们在里面还是外面提供茶点？

transcript.en: Isn't it better to be democratic?
transcript.zh: 民主不是更好吗？

transcript.en: It's a nice idea, but you have the ultimate responsibility. So, believe in what you think best.
transcript.zh: 这是个好主意，但你要付最终的责任。所以，相信你认为最好的。

transcript.en: Be prepared to say 'yes', that's a good idea but it won't work here.
transcript.zh: 准备好说“是”，这是一个好主意，但它在这里行不通。

transcript.en: I see what you mean. What about the networking side of things?
transcript.zh: 我明白你的意思。那么社交方面呢？

transcript.en: I know it's an area that a lot of students worry about  because we don't have much experience to offer others.
transcript.zh: 我知道这是很多学生担心的领域，因为我们没有太多的经验来为其他人提供。

transcript.en: But even without it  - you can still be an interesting person with useful ideas.And the more people you impress, the better.
transcript.zh: 但即使没有它，你仍然可以成为一个有想法的有趣的人。你给越多的人留下印象越好。

transcript.en: I guess that will help me when I apply for a real job.
transcript.zh: 我想当我申请一份真正的工作时，这对我有帮助。

transcript.en: Exactly - think ahead – remember what your ambitions are and keep them in mind.
transcript.zh: 确切地说，提前预见，记住你的抱负是什么，并牢记它们。

transcript.en: Definitely.
transcript.zh: 当然。
